title: phyllanthus casticum var. madagascariensis
intro: Phyllanthus casticum var. madagascariensis, commonly known as Madagascar phyllanthus or Madagascariensis, is a plant species in the family Phyllanthaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Phyllanthus casticum var. madagascariensis include immunomodulation, wound healing, and the treatment of various diseases such as hepatitis and diabetes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
